name: v2 Falco: decoded payload in container
description: Falco rule 'Decoding Payload in Container' fired — a base64 (or similar) decode inside a container, the staging step of a decode-and-run chain. Routine host activity does not decode payloads; triage answers what was decoded, whether it was then executed, and how the process reached the host. Falco's container.name is often <NA>; container.id identifies the host.
